creator: Alexander Terp
description: Two deferrals from council stage 1's review: a presence probe to a stopped Claude session whose socket backlog is full can block (std has no connect timeout for Unix sockets; a nonblocking raw connect would fix it, and pane participants now take presence from detection instead), and state.json is written through persist::write, the daemon's one durable path shared with tabs, which fsyncs more than messaging needs.
title: Presence probes have no connect timeout; state.json uses the durable writer
